IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [FusionID] [int] NOT NULL, [FusionAttributeTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Query] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery_Fusion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery_Fusion] FOREIGN KEY([FusionID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Fusion] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery_Fusion] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery_FusionAttributeType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery_FusionAttributeType] FOREIGN KEY([FusionAttributeTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeTypeCustomQuery_FusionAttributeType] END
